info.title: FlareID provisioning API
info.description: Everything the admin console does, without a browser. JSON in, JSON out; every mutation is audited against the token that made it. Each operation's `x-permission` names the permission it needs (see Permissions in docs/api.md): `<area>:read` or `<area>:write`, where write implies read, and `*` (an `admin` key) grants everything. The original scopes (`directory:read`, `directory:write`, `clients:write`, `settings:write`, `admin`) are shorthand for sets of permissions and keep working.
